title: cenchrus orientalis subsp. triflorum
intro: Cenchrus orientalis subsp. triflorum, commonly known as Three-flowered Broom-grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions like anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents present in Cenchrus orientalis subsp. triflorum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
